drugs.name: Alectinib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Alectinib is a second-generation ALK inhibitor designed to overcome resistance mutations and penetrate the blood-brain barrier.

drugs.name: Crizotinib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Crizotinib is a first-generation ALK inhibitor.

drugs.name: Bevacizumab
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Bevacizumab neutralizes VEGFA to inhibit angiogenesis.

drugs.name: Enzalutamide
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Enzalutamide binds the androgen receptor with high affinity and blocks its translocation into the nucleus.

drugs.name: Imatinib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Imatinib binds the ATP pocket of the BCR-ABL1 kinase, blocking its activity.

drugs.name: Olaparib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Olaparib inhibits PARP1, leading to cell death in BRCA-mutated cancers by exploiting synthetic lethality.

drugs.name: Osimertinib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Osimertinib selectively inhibits mutant EGFR, including T790M resistance mutations.

drugs.name: Erlotinib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Erlotinib inhibits EGFR tyrosine kinase activity.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Pembrolizumab blocks PD-1 to restore T cell ability to attack cancer cells.

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Rituximab binds to CD20 on B lymphocytes, triggering immune-mediated cell killing.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Binds to the extracellular domain of the HER2 receptor, blocking HER2 signaling and flagging cancer cells for immune destruction.

drugs.name: Pertuzumab
drugs.mechanism_of_action: HER2-targeted antibody that blocks receptor dimerization.

drugs.name: Vemurafenib
drugs.mechanism_of_action: Vemurafenib selectively inhibits the mutant BRAF V600E kinase.
